_meta.title: Elemental Relational Taxonomy — the near scales
_meta.role: The relational track of the relay. Same shape as taxonomy.json (3 sub-domains × 3 facets × 3 stances per element) and the same operator algebra, but the facets are written at the scale a person actually lives at: alone, with one other, inside a small group. Selected by SCOPE at the start of a relay — 'just me', 'me and one other', 'a team or group' land here; the organisational and planetary scopes stay on the strategic (PESTLE) track.
_meta.why: The operators are scale-invariant — distinction, coupling, direction, branching, metabolism, boundary read the same at every scale. The facets are not. The strategic taxonomy is a macro-environmental scan (PESTLE); asked to serve a couple or a household it offers 'digital tribes' and 'planetary governance'. This track supplies the missing register rather than rebuilding the algebra.
_meta.voice: Grounded in the Accounts, which are already six-element readings at this scale — σ(the_installed_frame), ρ(two_griefs_no_shared_shape), δγ(the_load_uncomposted). Those are instances; these are the types they are instances of.
_meta.phi_form: <operator>(<facet-slug> | <stance>) — identical to the strategic track, so chains, handoffs and the Sunday synthesis read across both
_meta.third_branch_rule: As in the strategic track, each element's third sub-domain looks forward and its final facet names that element's characteristic capture — the peril stance has something specific to bite on.

elements.strategy: Noticing, Framing & What Is Actually Here
elements.lens_question: What is actually here, before the story about it?

diagnostic.leads_when: the account of it has run ahead of the thing itself — you can say what it means before you can say what happened
diagnostic.blindness: mistakes a clean description for the whole of it; cannot feel what the distinction costs
capture_risk: naming a thing to be done with it
handoff_signs: you can describe it precisely and still cannot move
diagnostic.live_question: What would you have to admit is here, if no one needed you to have a position on it?

stance_frames.pressure: The story has outrun the fact — what is here has to be separated from what was said about it.
stance_frames.possibility: A distinction that clears the air without settling the matter — then hand the clarity on.
stance_frames.peril: The description hardening into the thing: knowing about it instead of meeting it.
